# Hours & Location

![cwb1.jpeg](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/1622688097282-1OL0YVHR30BJDVJHJNIG/cwb1.jpeg)

## Location

South Lake Union, inside Lake Union Park
1010 Valley Street, Seattle, WA 98109
Phone: (206) 382-2628

## 2026 Seasonal Hours (Wednesday through Sunday)

- **Winter (Jan 3 – Mar 13):** Museum 10:00 am – 4:00 pm. Boat rentals resume March 14, 2026.
- **Spring (Mar 14 – Apr 15):** 11:30 am – 7:00 pm
- **Summer (Apr 16 – Sep 6):** 12:30 pm – 8:00 pm
- **Autumn (Sep 10 – Oct 11):** 11:30 am – 7:00 pm
- **Winter (Oct 21, 2026 – Mar 19, 2027):** Museum 10:00 am – 4:00 pm. Boat rentals resume March 20, 2027.

Last boat out is 90 minutes before closing.

![Screenshot 2021-06-02](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/1622688677844-XS1RG4AEHC0E3Q0ZYRRT/Screenshot%2B2021-06-02%2Bat%2B19.30.38.jpg)

## Special Holiday Hours

- Memorial Day and Labor Day: 12:30 pm – 8:00 pm

## Closures

- The Wednesday after Memorial Day (May 27, 2026) and Labor Day (September 9, 2026)
- Independence Day (July 4)
- [TWSBA Conference](https://teachingwithsmallboats.org/conferences/) (October 12–20)
- Thanksgiving (November 26)
- Winter Holiday (December 14, 2026 – January 2, 2027)

No boat rentals or museum access during closures.

Admission is always free. See our [free programs at SLU](https://www.cwb.org/free-programs). Boat rentals are available at the Livery.
